gloss: to finish writing; to complete (a work)

forms.label: Past polite
forms.negative: {書|か}き{上|あ}げませんでした

forms.negative: {書|か}き{上|あ}げていなかった

definitions.gloss: to finish writing; to complete writing
definitions.explanation: To complete a written work such as a manuscript, novel, report, or thesis. Emphasizes the accomplishment of finishing the entire work.

examples.japanese: ⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{書|か}き{上|あ}げた。
⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ようやく→漸く：00429_youyaku⟧{書|か}き{上|あ}げた。
examples.english: I finally finished writing my novel.

examples.japanese: ⟦{報告書|ほうこくしょ}→報告書：06744_houkokusho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一晩|ひとばん}→一晩：08887_hitoban⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{書|か}き{上|あ}げた。
examples.english: I finished writing the report overnight.

examples.japanese: ⟦{論文|ろんぶん}→論文：03787_ronbun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{締|し}め{切|き}り→締め切り：04162_shimekiri⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{書|か}き{上|あ}げ⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: I have to finish writing the thesis before the deadline.

examples.english: I spent three months finishing the manuscript, but the editor asked for major revisions.

notes:
FORMATION:
Compound verb: ⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧ (to write) + ⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧ (to finish, to complete)

The ～⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧ pattern indicates completion of an action, often with a sense of accomplishment.

COLLOCATIONS:
・⟦{原稿|げんこう}→原稿：00064_genkou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{書|か}き{上|あ}げる - to finish a manuscript
・⟦{論文|ろんぶん}→論文：03787_ronbun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{書|か}き{上|あ}げる - to complete a thesis
・⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{書|か}き{上|あ}げる - to finish writing a novel
・⟦{企画書|きかくしょ}→企画書：20593_kikakusho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{書|か}き{上|あ}げる - to complete a proposal

SIMILAR COMPOUND VERBS:
・⟦{読|よ}み{上|あ}げる→読み上げる：04604_yomiageru⟧ - to finish reading / to read aloud
・⟦{作|つく}り{上|あ}げる→作り上げる：11569_tsukuriageru⟧ - to complete making
・⟦{仕上|しあ}げる→仕上げる：04664_shiageru⟧ - to finish, to complete (similar meaning)
